title: Fleet Hygiene Policy
description: Declarative, versioned fleet hygiene policy (epic fp-jan / Swabbie). Bahia holds the policy; per-host maintenance drivers enforce the projected subset. Safety invariants: quarantine-not-delete, dry-run-first, protected paths never touched, Tier-2 actions (relocate/purge) never automatic.

workers.description: Worker pubkeys this policy targets; empty = all configured maintenance workers

scan_roots.description: Absolute directories the janitor may scan

protected_paths.description: Absolute paths never scanned, quarantined, or purged (keys, Signet store, private corpus, backup domain)

retention_days.description: Minimum quarantine residency before purge is possible

backup_domain.description: Where backups belong; misplaced backups are relocated here, never deleted

canonical_clones.description: git origin URL -> canonical checkout path; a clone is a duplicate only when its canonical copy is verified

gc_commands.description: Safe reclamation commands (default: docker image/volume/builder prune)

method_acl.description: Per-method requester allowlists for tier-gated methods (maintenance/purge, maintenance/relocate -> Majordomo)

auto_quarantine.description: Tier-1: automatically quarantine unblocked dup-clone/cruft candidates (reversible)

auto_gc.description: Tier-1: automatically run gc when a pressure threshold breaches
